db_path.description: Absolute path to the KeePassXC database file.

keyfile_path.description: Absolute path to the key file used for database encryption. Leave empty to rely on password only.

start_minimized.description: If true, KeePassXC starts minimized to the system tray.

browser_enabled.description: If true, enables the KeePassXC-Browser extension integration.

allowed_hosts.description: List of domain names allowed to connect to KeePassXC via browser extension.

lock_after_secs.description: Time in seconds of inactivity after which the database is automatically locked.

require_master_key.description: If true, a master password is required in addition to the key file.

hide_passwords.description: If true, passwords are hidden (masked) in the entries list by default.
